outputs.explanation: These are spatial deconvolution heatmaps showing per-spot values overlaid on tissue images (each spot is an individual data point in itself). Heatmap-type visualizations are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual data points.

This is a box plot showing quartiles/median/min/max as described in the caption. Box plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since they already convey the distribution; the figure additionally shows scattered points overlaid on the boxes.
These are GSEA enrichment score line plots. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would not be meaningful/readable.

This is a bar chart showing log2 fold-change values (a derived/aggregate statistic per gene) from differential expression analysis across many spatial spots/samples, with only a single bar per gene and no individual data points (e.g., per-sample or per-spot values) overlaid.
This panel consists of H&E and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
